column3: Notifies owner and opens windows\nwhen battery is low or Pet mode exits
1. Unlock with physical key or phone key (Bluetooth connected) to exit car wash mode\n2. When unlocked, hold the door handle lock button for 6s to exit car wash mode

1. For conveyor car washes, fold the mirrors and shift to N. Stay in the car; leaving it shifts to P.
2. If Auto Hold is off, you can shift to N.
3. If Auto Hold is on, turn it off first, then shift to N.
Note: in P, unbuckle the driver seatbelt or press the brake firmly to turn off Auto Hold

When Car Wash mode is on, Park Comfort turns on, climate switches to recirculation, and all windows, the trunk and the charge port lid close. These are disabled: keyless entry, charge port lid switch, auto wipers, obstacle alerts, walk-up unlock / walk-away lock.

Note: Car Wash mode exits automatically above 15 km/h.

Automatic car wash: keep battery above 20% and do not move the car, otherwise Car Wash mode exits when the driver leaves. For conveyor car washes, fold the mirrors and shift to N. Stay in the car; leaving it shifts to P.
